NP Presspad 1.3.1 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — build tooling only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Under the hood

The database engine moved to a new kind of build in 1.3.0, one that no longer has to be recompiled separately for each runtime. This release removes the machinery that existed only to do that recompiling — a test wrapper, two build steps, a pinned dependency and a setup instruction, none of which had anything left to do.

No behaviour changes, and nothing to do on your side.
